messages:
Sam: Anyone else seeing missing child spans for async-prefetcher traces since ~09:00 UTC? Grafana traces dashboard has a bunch of flat traces (no children) and Jaeger shows gaps. https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/traces/async-prefetcher

Anya: Yep, noticed it on a few customer requests. Seems to happen right after batch flush. Could be sampler or exporter errors.

Kevin: Config lives in infra/helm/values/otel.yaml — we set sampler to traceidratio: 0.01 for cost reasons. I can check if the worker is overriding it.

Priya: Also check logs for exporter errors. I saw a couple of lines like `failed to export spans: EOF` yesterday on one node. Command: `kubectl logs -l app=async-prefetcher -c prefetcher --since=3h | grep -i otel`

Sam: running that now, quick paste:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z prefetcher info exporter.go:47 sending batch size=32
2026-03-17T09:12:04Z prefetcher warn exporter.go:58 failed to export spans: connection reset by peer
2026-03-17T09:12:04Z prefetcher debug sampler.go:112 span dropped due to sampler decision
```

Anya: hmm exporter connection resets + low traceidratio would both explain missing children (either never sampled or failed to send). Which exporter are we using? OTLP/gRPC to observability-proxy in staging?

Kevin: Yes OTLP/gRPC -> obs-proxy. I just looked: the worker helm chart had an accidental override: `otel.traces.sampler: traceidratio` and `otel.traces.sampler.arg: 0.01` at the chart level. I'll open a quick PR to set arg to 0.1 for the prefetcher and add a healthcheck for exporter errors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3421

Priya: Can we suppress the high_trace_drop_rate alert while we roll this? It's noisy and currently fires for a bunch of traces. I'd rather annotate the alert and raise threshold temporarily. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/alerts/tracing-overview

ops-bot: alert: high_trace_drop_rate (async-prefetcher) triggered — severity=warning — firing_time=2026-03-17T09:14:00Z

Sam: @Kevin please ping me on the PR. For alert tuning: temporary change + a 1-hour annotation sounds good. @Priya can you file the alert annotation/incident?

Priya: Filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-1789 — added note that we're bumping sampling for prefetcher and watching exporter errors. I'll add a 1h suppress.

Kevin: PR opened and added unit test to ensure helm values propagate: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3421 — cc @Sam. Planning a canary deploy to 2 pods, then roll.

Anya: Thanks — when canary is up, can someone run a few synthetic traces and confirm children appear? I can run the synthetic probe if you want.

Sam: I'll trigger the probe after canary: `scripts/trace_probe.sh --service async-prefetcher --count 50` — please watch Jaeger and Grafana.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for infra PR #3421 -> env=staging, pods rolling: async-prefetcher-5 -> async-prefetcher-6

Kevin: Deploying now. Will post results in ~10m. If exporter errors persist after bumping sampling, we'll open follow-up to investigate obs-proxy TLS/keepalive settings.

Sam: Awesome. If anyone sees new alerts after the canary step, please @mention #eng-oncall and link OBS-1789.

Priya: Noted — I'll keep the suppress active for 1h and monitor metrics (export_error_rate, sampled_spans_per_min).
